text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered PD-INC-78901 - Elevated 500s and timeouts on kv-cache-proxy in us-east-1. Redis cluster 'cache-primary' reporting CLIENTS hitting limit; p95 request latency rising from ~180ms -> 3.6s. Affected: inference-write, metrics-ingest, realtime-features.

mira: acked on PD. I'm pulling up dashboards and latest deploys. Any scheduled jobs or config flips in the last hour?

oliver: infra had a config push 37m ago to the job-scheduler (changed concurrency defaults). Not infra deploys to proxy or DB.

sam: seeing a huge spike in redis rejected connections and slow commands. From redis-cli INFO CLIENTS dump:

```
connected_clients: 9995
maxclients: 10000
rejected_connections_total: 4128
slowlog_last_id: 98765
```

sam: also observing many clients in CMD state "MULTI" from pods named analytics-agg-*. They're repeatedly reconnecting.

mira: initial thought: scheduler change accidentally increased concurrency for analytics-agg-job which opens many short-lived Redis connections and doesn't reuse them. That plus a small memcached eviction loop is causing backlog and proxy 502/504s.

db-team: pgbouncer looks okay on our side; pool usage is moderate. PG spikes are small but there are many auth attempts from analytics pods that look like they bypass pooled clients.

infra-bot: recent job-scheduler commit: https://git.company/job-scheduler/commit/abc123 - default concurrency bumped from 5 -> 50 for batch jobs.

oliver: confirmed. That change rolled 37m ago. It explains the sudden fanout of analytics pods.

mira: mitigation plan:
- immediate: quarantine analytics-agg job (scale to 1), cordon problematic nodes if necessary
- add headroom: apply temporary redis-sentinel config to accept more clients or add node (fast path)
- patch job-scheduler to revert concurrency default and make client pool reuse mandatory
- customer comms: prepare status page note only if customer-facing errors continue >15m

pagerduty: PD-INC-78901 acknowledged by mira. Escalation in 8m if not resolved.

oliver: scaling down analytics-agg to 1 instance now. Scaling commands sent.

sam: after scaling down, I still see spikes because old pods are in CrashLoopBackoff and restarting constantly, each restart making connections. We should evict them so their controllers don't recreate too fast.

mira: evicting controllers and setting backoff for that job group.

```
# kubectl commands
kubectl scale job analytics-agg --replicas=0 -n production
kubectl delete pod -l app=analytics-agg -n production --grace-period=0 --force
```

sam: done. Old pods deleted. Connected_clients dropping -> 2600. rejected_connections_total trending to zero.

db-team: verifying pgbouncer auth bypass: found 12 direct connections from analytics nodes. Adding rule to force all app traffic through pgbouncer (iptables) as emergency mitigation.

oliver: applying iptables redirect on affected nodes via runbook-runner.

infra-bot: new redis node request submitted (autoscale group) - provisioning ETA ~4m. We won't change maxclients (needs restart) — adding capacity by node.

mira: monitoring latency and 5xx counts.

sam: p95 for kv-write now down from 3.6s -> 240ms over last 3m. 5xx rate decreased by 93%.

infra-bot: new redis node joined cluster, replication sync done. Connected_clients stable ~1800, rejects=0.

mira: great. Marking mitigation as successful for now. Next: permanent fixes and post-incident actions.

Post-incident action items (owner in parentheses):
- revert dangerous default in job-scheduler & add required connection pool for jobs (oliver)
- add exponential backoff and connection pooling to analytics-agg client library (sam)
- add alert: "redis rejected connections > 10 in 5m" and "rapid pod restart spike" (sre-night)
- update pgbouncer runbook to enforce pool-only access and fail closed for bypass attempts (db-team)
- consider redis cluster headroom auto-scale during batch windows (infra)

mira: creating a postmortem draft and assigning owners. I'll own the timeline + customer impact section.

sre-night: I'm taking overnight watch. If rejected_connections_total > 0 for 10m, page on-call DB and infra.

mira: status page draft (to be posted if errors persist):
- Impact: Elevated errors and latency for inference write and dependent services in us-east-1 due to a runaway analytics job that saturated Redis client capacity. Mitigations applied, monitoring.
- Scope: A subset of customers experienced increased latency and transient 5xx errors between T0 and T0+42m.

infra-bot: incident PD-INC-78901 status -> mitigated; duration 42m. Runbook artifacts stored at /incidents/PD-78901/.

mira: filing postmortem, linking here when ready: https://docs.company/incidents/PD-78901-draft

oliver: follow-up: schedule a small load test for job scheduler changes and add guardrails in CI that fail if concurrency jump > 3x.

sam: opened PR to add pooling/backoff: https://git.company/analytics-client/pulls/88

db-team: follow-up: enforce pgbouncer-only connections by default in prod images and add a CI smoke test.

sre-night: acked handoff. I'll escalate if metrics regress.

mira: thanks all. Closing this thread; please postmortem in the docs when ready. :white_check_mark:
